messages:
emma (AM): FYI AcmeHealth legal requested SOC 2 artifacts, a signed pen-test letter, and temporary scan access to our POC. they ask for IP allowlist or short-lived bastion.
sofia (Sales Eng): do they need full Type II or redacted? also any KMS attestation notes?
emma (AM): redacted SOC2 + control mappings ok. want confirmation about KMS for Dedicated vs hosted.
ramon (Security): we can share redacted SOC2 PDF and Controls Matrix. pen-test letter needs scope (IPs + window) before we sign.
zoe (EngOps): options for scans: bastion with ephemeral key, allowlist scanner IPs, or provide exported logs.
emma (AM): they prefer IP allowlist. sent: "scanner will run out-of-hours, <1000 conn/min, target 10.23.40.0/24"
ramon (Security): prepping redacted SOC2 + matrix and pen-test attestation. sample letter below, will sign once scope confirmed.
ramon (Security): ```Penetration Test Acknowledgement
Company: Redwood Inference Inc.
Scope: testing limited to <IP range> during <window>.
Allowed: external/app tests.
Prohibited: DoS, social engineering.
POC: security@redwood.com
Signature: Ramon Alvarez```
zoe (EngOps): send CIDR and scanner contact; we can allowlist same-day and monitor. bastion ~24h.
ramon (Security): uploading artifacts by 2391023365; will email signed PDF by 2391023405. tagging @sre-bot to create ticket.
sre-bot: Created INFRA-5429 for scan monitoring. ETA 4h.
emma (AM): i'll update customer: SOC2 link, signed letter, confirm allowlist.
sofia (Sales Eng): sharing KMS blurb: "Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (attestation). Dedicated: BYOK support; config doc attached."
zoe (EngOps): will confirm when allowlist live.
emma (AM): customer scheduled Friday 02:00-04:00 UTC. all set. :thumbsup:
